jobs.job_title: Senior Cloud Security Architect, Mandiant, Cloud and Infrastructure
jobs.job_description:
Applicants to this role must have work authorization in Saudi Arabia as this role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:

In-office locations: Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Remote location(s): Saudi Arabia.
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of technical cybersecurity experience, and experience in cloud architecture, enterprise infrastructure, and threat defense.

• Experience leading on-premises-to-cloud migrations or multi-cloud consolidation/remediation projects.

• Experience serving as a technical mentor and advisor to client leadership (CISO, CIO, VP of Infrastructure/Engineering) to deliver operational and cultural security change.

• Experience defining technical requirements, engineering roadmaps, and delivering architecture reviews across multi-stakeholder engagements.

• Must be eligible to secure and maintain High-Level Saudi Arabian National Security and Defense Clearances, equivalent to UK Developed Vetting (DV) clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience designing and securing Google Cloud or other cloud platforms, including native security tools, Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies, and VPC controls.

• Expertise in IAM, identity federation, PAM, and workload identity across hybrid enterprise environments.

• Experience with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD security gating, infrastructure as code, and CSPM/CWPP tooling.

• Ability to map adversary tactics to defenses, and hold professional security certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP).

• Ability to deconstruct technical risks into clear narratives for executives and board-level stakeholders.

• Ability to travel up to 50% across Saudi Arabia and the wider region.

About the job

Mandiant’s Security Transformation Services (STS) team partners directly with organizations navigating complex, high-stakes security transformations.

We are seeking a direct, field-tested Cloud Security Architect who has operated directly on the frontlines of major enterprise cloud transformations. You will work side-by-side with clients who are either transitioning critical workloads from traditional on-premises environments to cloud, or dealing with fragmented, multi-cloud sprawl where security controls, governance, and visibility are inconsistent.

You understand the true challenges of cloud adoption. Crucially, because client leadership often lacks visibility into the operational realities and cultural shifts required for cloud security, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor and mentor—translating modern threat realities into clear architectural blueprints, updated operating models, and roadmaps that bridge engineering teams and executive management.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.

Responsibilities

• Serve as the technical authority guiding clients through migrations from legacy on-premises datacenters to modern cloud, and rationalizing and elevating sprawling, fragmented multi-cloud footprints.

• Redesign cloud security architectures, modernize operational workflows (SecOps, DevSecOps, identity governance, CI/CD pipeline security), and enforce resilient security baselines aligned with Mandiant frontline threat intelligence.

• Bridge the communication gap between technical practitioners and senior management. Educate and coach client executives, business leaders, and engineering leads on why security transformation is necessary, how their operating model must adapt to cloud.

• Assist client teams in implementing pragmatic, defensive controls—such as Zero Trust access models, workload identity federation, infrastructure-as-code (IaC) guardrails, container/Kubernetes security, and cloud network micro-segmentation.

• Translate root causes from active breach investigations into long-term architectural uplifts and measurable mitigation programs. Produce actionable, architectural blueprints, operating model frameworks, and executive-ready roadmaps.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.job_title: Sr. Cloud Application Architect, MENAT Professional Services Delivery
jobs.job_description:
DESCRIPTION

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries

Key job responsibilities

As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:

• Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs

• Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery

• Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies

• Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies

• Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

A day in the life

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

About the team

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations, or experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

• Experience leading highly-available and fault-tolerant enterprise and web-scale software deployments

• Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion

• Experience leading software development organizations in a "DevOps" model

• 5+ years of working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations experience

• Experience in Kubernetes, Docker or containers ecosystem, or experience with virtualization (Hypervisors, VMware, Xen) and experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP

• Experience deploying, managing, and optimizing Microsoft Windows Server, or experience working with REST API based services and experience in any Bigdata architecture

• Experience developing cloud native CI/CD workflows and tools, such as Jenkins, Bamboo, TeamCity, Code Deploy (AWS) or GitLab

• Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis) experience

• Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

• Experience working with partners through account, product or program management and business development engagements

• Experience as a technical account nanager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect or in a similar role

• Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS

• Experience with designing and building applications using container and serverless technologies

• 7+ years of mainframe and legacy systems experience

• Experience with database management systems

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Job Summary
The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for a Cloud Architect - AI to join us in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will work as a subject matter expert in Red Hat's infrastructure and cloud technology with main focus on Red Hat AI and MLOps. You'll answer questions about best practices around automation, reliability, scalability, maintainability, high availability, and failover setups and lead the on-site delivery and implementation of Red Hat's technology that delivers freedom, flexibility, and outstanding performance. You will gain an understanding of our customers' infrastructures, and business issues and you will make recommendations appropriate to their environments. This is a great opportunity to build on your core base of knowledge and work in a fast-paced environment promoting Red Hat's solutions.
What You Will Do
• Serve as a customer advocate, designing the right solutions and ensuring that they are implemented and supported in an innovative and reliable way
• Deliver successful discovery, analysis, and design workshops for small to medium teams of both technical and non-technical backgrounds that shape and inspire customer use cases and architecture design decisions
• Scope delivery projects and guide customers through successful pilot and production deployments
• Design, create, and deliver content that will enable the broader Red Hat organization to sell, service, and support our cloud and infrastructure solutions at scale
• Contribute to the development of repeatable methodologies and tools designed to scale Red Hat's services capabilities, promote repeated customer engagements, and lower delivery risks
• Contribute to, and lead the delivery of Red Hat solutions based on the Red Hat tools and technologies

What You Will Bring
• Prior experience working in a consulting role; ability to deliver in one-on-one assignments
• Good customer-facing skills; ability to present to customers and lead customer interactions
• Excellent knowledge of cloud and infrastructure technologies on a delivery level
• Experience implementing container technologies in an enterprise setting and with enterprise-wide deployments
• Knowledge of one or more Red Hat's infrastructure solutions like Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform and Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform
• Understanding of the open source community
• Excellent problem-solving and planning skills
• Good written and verbal language skills in Arabic and English

The Following Are Considered a Plus
• Strong knowledge of AI technologies and Red Hat OpenShift AI
• Experience onboarding applications and application teams onto cloud or container platforms introducing DevOps, continuous delivery (CD) and application lifecycle management, and GitOps
• Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA) certification
• Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) certification

About Red Hat
Red Hat is the world's leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat's culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email [HIDDEN TEXT]. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

Job Summary
• Technical leader with an impact level defined by the ability to design critical systems and influence technology strategy. Operating primarily within the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) the role is responsible for designing secure, scalable, and reliable cloud solutions that address customer requirements and business objectives. the role's mindset is focused on collaboration and long-term vision, ensuring the architecture is sound and aligns with key business objectives. This role involves mentoring others and promoting reusables and scalable architectural principles for modern cloud infrastructure

Principal Duties & Detailed Job Description
• System design: lead the architectural design of large-scale systems, focusing on resilient and well-architected technical environments
• Technology standards: evaluate and select technologies, defining standards and best practices for the department
• Team mentorship: mentor and guide other architects and technical leads to help elevate the team's overall capabilities
• Strategic alignment: collaborate with leadership to align the technology roadmap with strategic business goals

Qualification Requirements

Education Requirements

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related technical field

Work Experience

6+ years of relevant experience with a significant portion in an architectural role, including hands-on experience designing and implementing cloud solutions, preferably on GCP (not only presales & Advisory)

Certification/License

Preferred: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification (or equivalent), Terraform professional, or recognized enterprise architecture credentials such as TOGAF

Language Skills

Professional working proficiency in English. Arabic is a plus

Functional Job Competencies
• System/solution architecture: proven expertise in designing secure, scalable and resilient distributed systems.
• Technical influence: demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and lead architectural governance
• Communication: exceptional communication skills to articulate complex solutions to any audience

jobs.job_description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Energy team is seeking a Technical Business Developer to drive regional strategy for energy in the Middle East. You will identify where data and AI unlock value across the energy value chain, from upstream to LNG, and shape solutions with customers, ISVs, and partners.

You will build reference architectures, develop content, and mentor peers while pursuing complex deals that deliver real outcomes for energy operators in the region.
